Birds Nests
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:36am

Ingredients




1 pkt butterscotch morsels (12 oz.)
1 can La Choy chow mein noodles (15 oz.)
1 cup unsalted peanuts

Preparation

1 Over double boiler pan, let water come to a boil, lower heat. Add butterscotch morsels to the pan. When the butterscotch has melted to a creamy consistency, add the noodles and peanuts. Mix well. put a piece of waxed paper on a cookie sheet. Place the cookie sheet in refrigerator to cool and harden. Keep refrigerated until ready to eat. makes 2 dozen
